name: commission an infographic
x-status: proposed instance. No runbook form exists yet in lib/agency; this is written in the shape of a duty (from/to/cost/otherwise/receiver-condition) plus ordered steps, and the gap is recorded in system-debt record 2026-10-24-infographic-forms-unadmitted.
trigger: A receiver (a research paper, a video shot list, a page) asks for an infographic, or a Climate Place-By-Place figure is due. The norm: every published infographic is a spec plus data with provenance, not a hand-drawn or model-generated picture.

steps.name: Qualify the request
steps.who: senior-engineer (human or agent), says so in the record
steps.action: Name the receiver, the canvas (landscape-16x9, portrait-9x16, square), the message in one sentence, and the data. Refuse and return the request if any number has no source.

steps.name: Fetch the data with provenance
steps.action: Download open data; commit it under data/ with the retrieval date, URL and licence in the source line. Mark anything invented as provenance kind fixture or illustrative.

steps.name: Write the spec
steps.action: Compose blocks from the schema. Prefer a builder script (examples/build-example-specs.mjs) when the data is a file, so the spec is reproducible from data.

steps.name: Render
steps.check: no warnings; refusal means trim content or choose a taller canvas

steps.name: Rasterize frames when video needs them
steps.check: PNG at the requested size; digest of the SVG recorded

steps.name: Look at it
steps.action: Open the PNG. The scorer does not judge illustration, taste or whether the message is clear. Return to step 3 if it is not.

steps.name: Hand over and receive
steps.action: Give the receiver the SVG, PNGs, the spec and the report. The receiver, not the producer, accepts. Record the SVG digest in the receiving record.

rollback: Nothing outside the repository is changed by rendering. To roll back a handed-over infographic, supply the receiver with the previous SVG digest's file from version control and record that the later digest is withdrawn. A golden-digest change in this repository is reverted by reverting the commit that changed the engine or spec; never by editing the digest alone.
refusals: content does not fit at the minimum scale
glyph missing from the shipped fonts
non-observed data without a provenance badge
